Rashi on Berakhot 17a:11:1.english: The purpose of wisdom - The essence of Torah is that repentance and good deeds should accompany it.

Rashi on Berakhot 17a:11:2.hebrew: העושה שלא לשמה נוח לו שלא נברא - פירוש: שאינו לומד כדי לקיים, אלא לקנטר. דבפרק מקום שנהגו (פסחים דף נ:) אמרינן: רבא רמי, כתיב ״עד שמים חסדך״, וכתיב ״מעל השמים״ — כאן בעוסק שלא לשמה כו׳; והתם איירי במקיים כדי שיכבדוהו. וכן משמע בירושלמי דפירקין:
Rashi on Berakhot 17a:11:2.english: One who acts not for its own sake, it would have been better for him had he not been created - [The] explanation [is] that he does not study in order to fulfill [the mitzvot], but rather to provoke [others]. For in the chapter “Mekom Shenahagu” (Pesachim 50b), we say: Rava raised a contradiction: It is written, “Unto the heavens is Your kindness,” and it is written, “[Your kindness is] above the heavens” — here [where it reaches unto the heavens, it refers to] one who engages [in Torah] not for its own sake, etc.; and there, it is dealing with one who fulfills [the mitzvot] in order that they honor him. And so it is implied in the Jerusalem Talmud of our chapter.

Rashi on Berakhot 17a:12:1.hebrew: ויאכלו וישתו - שבעו מזיו השכינה, כאילו אכלו ושתו:
Rashi on Berakhot 17a:12:1.english: And they ate and drank - They were satiated from the splendor of the Divine Presence, as if they had eaten and drunk.

Rashi on Berakhot 17a:13:1.hebrew: גדולה הבטחה - שהרי קראן שאננות ובוטחות:
Rashi on Berakhot 17a:13:1.english: Greater is the promise - For [Scripture] called them "at ease" and "confident".

Rashi on Berakhot 17a:14:1.hebrew: לבי כנישתא - תינוקות של בית רבן היו רגילין להיות למדים לפני רבן בבית הכנסת:
Rashi on Berakhot 17a:14:1.english: To the synagogue - Schoolchildren were accustomed to study before their teacher in the synagogue.

Rashi on Berakhot 17a:14:2.hebrew: בי רבנן - בית המדרש, ששם שונים משנה וגמרא:
Rashi on Berakhot 17a:14:2.english: The house of the Rabbis - The study hall, where they study Mishnah and Gemara.

Rashi on Berakhot 17a:14:3.hebrew: ונטרן לגברייהו - ממתינות לבעליהן, ונותנות להם רשות ללכת וללמוד תורה בעיר אחרת:
Rashi on Berakhot 17a:14:3.english: And waiting for their husbands - They wait for their husbands, and give them permission to go and study Torah in another city.

Rashi on Berakhot 17a:15:1.hebrew: מפטרי רבנן - זה מזה, שהיה נוטל רשות מחבירו לשוב לביתו ולארצו:
Rashi on Berakhot 17a:15:1.english: The Sages took leave - From one another, as [each] would take leave of his fellow to return to his home and his land.

Rashi on Berakhot 17a:15:2.hebrew: עולמך תראה בחייך - כל צרכיך תמצא:
Rashi on Berakhot 17a:15:2.english: May you see your world in your lifetime - May you find all your needs.

Rashi on Berakhot 17a:15:3.hebrew: פיך ידבר חכמות - בלשון ברכה היו אומרים:
Rashi on Berakhot 17a:15:3.english: Your mouth shall speak wisdom - They would say [it] in the form of a blessing.

Rashi on Berakhot 17a:15:4.hebrew: יישירו - לשון יושר, שתהא מבין בתורה כהלכה:
Rashi on Berakhot 17a:15:4.english: Look directly - An expression of straightness: that you will understand the Torah properly.

Rashi on Berakhot 17a:1:1.hebrew: בפמליא של מעלה - בחבורת שרי האומות, שכשהשרים של מעלה יש תגר ביניהם, תיכף יש קטטה בין האומות, כדכתיב: ועתה אשוב להלחם עם שר פרס (דניאל י׳:כ׳):
Rashi on Berakhot 17a:1:1.english: In the heavenly entourage - In the company of the princes of the nations, for when the princes on High have strife between them, immediately there is conflict between the nations, as it is written: "And now I will return to fight with the prince of Persia" (Daniel 10:20).

Rashi on Berakhot 17a:1:2.english: And in the earthly entourage - In the company of the Sages.

Rashi on Berakhot 17a:2:1.english: In a lighted corner - In a corner of light.

Rashi on Berakhot 17a:2:2.hebrew: ומי מעכב - שאין אנו עושים רצונך:
Rashi on Berakhot 17a:2:2.english: And what prevents [us] - That we do not perform Your will.

Rashi on Berakhot 17a:2:3.english: The leaven in the dough - The evil inclination in our hearts, which sours us.

Rashi on Berakhot 17a:3:1.hebrew: איני כדאי - לא הייתי חשוב והגון להיות נוצר:
Rashi on Berakhot 17a:3:1.english: I am not worthy - I was not important and worthy to be created.

Rashi on Berakhot 17a:3:2.hebrew: ועכשיו שנוצרתי - מה חשיבותי? הרי אני כאילו לא נוצרתי:
Rashi on Berakhot 17a:3:2.english: And now that I have been created - What is my importance? Behold, I am as if I had not been created.

Rashi on Berakhot 17a:3:3.english: All the more so - That in my death I am dust.

Rashi on Berakhot 17a:3:4.english: Cleanse - Eradicate and bring [them] to an end.

Rashi on Berakhot 17a:6:1.english: When he would conclude the Book of Job - Because Job passed away with a good name.

Rashi on Berakhot 17a:7:1.hebrew: מרגלא בפומיה - דבר זה רגיל בפיו:
Rashi on Berakhot 17a:7:1.english: [It was] habitual in his mouth - This matter was regular in his mouth.

Rashi on Berakhot 17a:8:1.hebrew: אני - העוסק בתורה — בריה אני, וכן חברי עם הארץ — בריה הוא:
Rashi on Berakhot 17a:8:1.english: I - [I,] the one who engages in Torah [study], am a creature [of God], and likewise my fellow, the common person [am ha'aretz], is a creature [of God].

Rashi on Berakhot 17a:8:2.hebrew: אני מלאכתי בעיר - כלומר, נוחה מלאכתי ממלאכתו:
Rashi on Berakhot 17a:8:2.english: I, my work is in the city - That is to say, my work is easier than his work.

Rashi on Berakhot 17a:8:3.english: Presumes - Aggrandizes himself to take up my trade.

Rashi on Berakhot 17a:8:4.hebrew: ושמא תאמר - הדין עמו שאינו מתגדר במלאכתי, שאילו היה תופס אומנותי, לא היה לו לב פתוח להרבות בתורה כמותי, והיה ממעיט, ואין לו שכר:
Rashi on Berakhot 17a:8:4.english: And lest you say - He is justified in not presuming to engage in my work, for had he taken up my profession, he would not have an open heart [i.e., the capacity] to study much Torah as I do, and he would [only] study a little, and [thus] have no reward.

Rashi on Berakhot 17a:8:5.hebrew: שנינו - שיש לו שכר לממעיט כמו למרבה:
Rashi on Berakhot 17a:8:5.english: We have learned - That there is reward for one who does little just as for one who does much.

Rashi on Berakhot 17a:8:6.hebrew: ובלבד שיכוין לבו לשמים - ואצל קרבנות הוא במנחות בסופה:
Rashi on Berakhot 17a:8:6.english: Provided that he directs his heart toward Heaven - And regarding sacrifices, it is in Menachot at its end.

Rashi on Berakhot 17a:9:1.hebrew: ערום ביראה - להערים בכל מיני ערמה ליראת בוראו:
Rashi on Berakhot 17a:9:1.english: Shrewd in fear - To act shrewdly with all kinds of shrewdness for the fear of his Creator.

Tosafot on Berakhot 17a:11:1.hebrew: העושה שלא לשמה נוח לו שלא נברא - וא"ת: האמר רב יהודה אמר רב פרק מקום שנהגו (פסחים ד' נ:): "לעולם יעסוק אדם בתורה ובמצות, אפי' שלא לשמה, שמתוך שלא לשמה בא לשמה"? וי"ל: דהכא מיירי שאינו לומד אלא לקנתר חביריו, והתם מיירי שלומד ע"מ שיכבדוהו:
Tosafot on Berakhot 17a:11:1.english: One who does [so] not for its own sake, it would have been better for him had he not been created - And if you say: Didn't Rav Yehudah say in the name of Rav in the chapter "Makom Shenahagu" (Pesachim 50b): "A person should always engage in Torah and mitzvot, even not for their own sake, for from [doing so] not for their own sake, he comes to [do so] for their own sake"? And one can answer that here it is dealing with one who studies only to provoke his fellows, whereas there it is dealing with one who studies in order that they honor him.

Tosafot on Berakhot 17a:4:1.hebrew: ונפשי כעפר לכל תהיה - מה עפר אינו מקבל כליה לעולם, כן יהי רצון שזרעי לא יכלה לעולם, כמו שהוא אומר: "והיה זרעך כעפר הארץ":
Tosafot on Berakhot 17a:4:1.english: "And may my soul be like dust to all" - Just as dust never suffers destruction, so may it be [Your] will that my offspring will never be destroyed, as it says: "And your seed shall be like the dust of the earth" (Genesis 28:14).

Tosafot on Berakhot 17a:8:1.hebrew: אני בריה וחברי בריה - כלומר, יש לו לב כמוני להבחין בין טוב לרע:
Tosafot on Berakhot 17a:8:1.english: I am a creature and my fellow is a creature - That is to say, he has a heart like mine to distinguish between good and evil.
